question: Should the first experimental grouped-update release permit unreceipted package and Gateway mutations with `update_partial` plus manual inspection/replanning, or require a durable doctor/retry/reconcile operation before merge?
rationale: The implementation can report and contain uncertainty, but only maintainers can set the acceptable operator-recovery and rollout contract for state-changing external boundaries.

options.title: Require recovery proof and contract
options.body: Keep the PR paused until exact-head external-boundary proof is supplied and maintainers explicitly accept or refine the doctor/retry/reconcile recovery path.

options.title: Accept the initial fail-closed contract
options.body: Approve `update_partial` plus operator inspection and replanning as the experimental recovery behavior after reviewing the missing live evidence.

options.title: Defer apply mutations
options.body: Land only the planning stack for now and postpone grouped update execution until a durable recovery design is ready.

recommendation.title: Require recovery proof and contract
recommendation.body: Keep the PR paused until exact-head external-boundary proof is supplied and maintainers explicitly accept or refine the doctor/retry/reconcile recovery path.

likelyOwner.reason: Their review comment identifies the precise unresolved recovery and live-proof decision.
